description.value:
Your presence alone unsettles others. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in Intimidation, or expertise in it if already proficient. When you take the Attack action, you may forgo one attack to try to unnerve a humanoid within 30 feet that can see and hear you: make a Charisma (Intimidation) check contested by its Wisdom (Insight) check. If you succeed, it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn; if you fail, it is immune to being frightened by you this way for the next hour.
